# Brusheezy

> > Brusheezy is a free resource library providing thousands of Photoshop, Illustrator, and Lightroom brushes in ABR, PSD, and vector formats for digital artists and designers.

The platform offers extensive collections of digital art brushes spanning artistic effects (oil painting, watercolor, crayon), natural elements (smoke, clouds, sky), lighting effects (sparkle, shine, spotlight), and decorative elements (flourishes, doodles, geometric shapes). All resources are available as free downloads in industry-standard formats compatible with Adobe Creative Suite applications.

## Key Topics

- Photoshop brushes
- Free digital art resources
- ABR and PSD formats
- Texture brushes
- Paint and watercolor effects
- Smoke and atmospheric effects
- Light and sparkle effects
- Design brush packs
- Adobe Illustrator brushes
- Digital painting tools
- Vintage ornaments and flourishes
- Geometric shape brushes
- Cloud and sky textures
- Lens flares and lighting
- Hand-drawn doodle brushes

## Artistic & Painting Brushes

- [Paint Free Brushes](https://www.brusheezy.com/free/paint): 6,196 free paint, splatter & watercolor Photoshop brushes from Brusheezy
- [Oil Painting Free Brushes](https://www.brusheezy.com/free/oil-painting): 791 free oil painting & watercolor Photoshop brushes for digital art
- [Crayon Free Brushes](https://www.brusheezy.com/free/crayon): 1,239 free crayon & pencil texture brushes for Photoshop/Illustrator
- [Pen Free Brushes](https://www.brusheezy.com/free/pen): 663 free pen, ink & calligraphy Photoshop/Illustrator brushes in ABR/PSD
- [Doodle Free Brushes](https://www.brusheezy.com/free/doodle): 805 free hand-drawn doodle & sketchy Photoshop brushes from Brusheezy
